description: A worker applying wet gypsum plaster to an interior wall with a trowel.
A polished moonstone cabochon gemstone glowing with a blue-white adularescent sheen on a dark background.
Flag of the Algerian FLN: vertical green and white halves with a red crescent and star in the centre.
French general Jacques Massu in paratrooper uniform with a red beret, Algiers 1957, black-and-white photographic style.
1960s film poster artwork for The Battle of Algiers showing French paratroopers in the narrow streets of the Casbah.
Small civilian boats crowded with soldiers leaving the Dunkirk beaches under a smoky sky, May 1940, black-and-white photographic style.
1976 first-edition book cover of Alex Haley's Roots, bold title lettering with African drummers illustration.
Italian colonial soldiers advancing with artillery through the Ethiopian highlands, 1935, black-and-white photographic style.
Ethiopian soldiers marching in a military parade in Addis Ababa during the 1970s Derg era, colour photograph style.
Kenneth Kaunda raising a clenched fist salute at a Zambian independence-era political rally, 1960s photograph style.
Political map of West Africa in 1960 highlighting the Mali Federation (Senegal and Sudanese Republic) in one colour.
Julius Nyerere and Kwame Nkrumah together at an African independence celebration in the 1960s, photograph style.
Crowds of ZANU supporters waving flags at an election rally in Salisbury (Harare), 1980, photograph style.
Dry rural landscape with traditional homesteads in Matabeleland, Zimbabwe.
Green tobacco fields on a commercial farm in the Mashonaland highveld, Zimbabwe.
The plain green hardcover of Muammar Gaddafi's Green Book with gold Arabic and English title lettering.
The flags of Russia and Belarus flying side by side on flagpoles outside an official government building.
Official portrait of Kazakh president Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, an older man with glasses in a dark suit, against a neutral backdrop with the Kazakh flag.
A round lake filling a nuclear test crater (Atomic Lake) in the Kazakh steppe at the Semipalatinsk site, aerial view.
The giant mechanical Ruhnama book monument in Ashgabat, Turkmenistan, its huge pages open, photographed at dusk.
